title: Focused launcher runs leave TERMAL_TEST_RUN_ROOT unset, so test children sweep the shared system-temp termal/tests folder and hit Access is denied
outcome: A focused `cargo test --bin termal` under scripts/test-launcher.mjs gives every test process, child processes included, its own run root. No test sweeps or writes the shared %TEMP%\termal\tests folder while other sessions' runs use it.
acceptance: A preserved source and controlled, repository-local request/process-level discriminator establishes whether focused launches and their descendants inherit an isolated run root and whether another live run's unmarked fixture is selected by the legacy sweep; historical cross-run AccessDenied and ECONNRESET causality remain explicitly qualified where unproved.

The existing launcher/test-temp owner allocates and propagates an exclusive verified temporary root for each launched run and its descendants; focused execution never sweeps or recursively deletes outside that run's owned root, preserves link/path/cleanup protections, and changes no retry, timeout, test assertions or product behavior.

An assertion-first RED and final exact-input GREEN cover direct and descendant inheritance, two-run isolation with a live foreign-fixture control, success/failure retention and existing temp-root/launcher boundary regressions; independent Codex/Claude full-input reviews have no outstanding Medium+, deferred Lows are tracked, and complete source/test/review evidence is handed to Merger for its full gate.
